items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: I remember Dan Barrett telling me that when he was in Benny’s last big band, that Benny would rehearse the band without the rhythm section you know.

ctx.x: Exactly. And I remember one of our folks talking about that. Like you have to be your own rhythm section. You have to have that feel and that drive within yourself and then match it with whatever you’re surrounded with.

I remember Dan Barrett telling me that when he was in Benny’s last big band, that Benny would rehearse the band without the rhythm section you know. And he didn’t want to hear any toes tapping either. You know like they had to have such an internal sense of swing and rhythm, and he said it was really scary because he was watching them and listening. But he understood what he was driving at and it was very effective. The band really learned how to drive forward and I thought that’s — you know because Benny’s gift…
You studied his career — why do you think he was dubbed “The King of Swing?”
